validation.epoch_selection: median of the five fold best epochs (round half up)
validation.scheduler_selection: highest mean Batch 1 CV accuracy; ties use lower mean selected validation cross-entropy, then candidate order
validation.target_use: Batches 2-10 are evaluated once after source-only epoch selection and final Batch 1 fitting

implementation_assumptions.sgd_momentum: Momentum was not otherwise specified by the baseline configuration; use momentum=0.9 as requested.
implementation_assumptions.step_lr_step_size: The paper does not specify StepLR step_size; use step_size=10 as an implementation assumption. With max_epochs=30 and gamma=0.1, decay occurs after epochs 10 and 20.
implementation_assumptions.scheduler_control: Retain a no-scheduler candidate as the control and select the scheduler using Batch 1 cross-validation only.
